guides.title: 把晶片剖面變成可檢查的製程依存圖
guides.titleEn: Turn a chip cross-section into a checkable process dependency graph
guides.concept: 製程不只是工序清單。每一步必須取得特定的表面、材料或圖案狀態，並留下下一步能使用的結果。同一種沉積或清洗可在不同層重複出現，目的卻不同。先理解輸入與輸出，才能診斷為何一個缺陷跨數道工序後才被發現。
guides.conceptEn: A process flow is more than a list. Each operation requires a particular surface, material or pattern state and must leave a usable state for the next operation. A repeated deposition or clean can serve different purposes at different layers. Tracking states helps explain why a defect may become visible several operations after it originated.
procedure: 選擇公開資料中的簡化 MOS 電晶體剖面，在自己的圖上用不同顏色標出基板、介電層、閘極、接觸與互連；註明圖不是比例尺，也不套用先進節點尺寸。
對每一層填寫「已有材料、要新增或移除的材料、保護區域、可用的量測」。例如介電層中的接觸開口需要圖案轉移，但開口存在不代表接觸電阻已合格。
把沉積、塗阻、曝光、適用的曝光後烘烤、顯影、蝕刻、去阻與量測接成有向圖。只加入具有物理依存的箭頭；依選定光阻文件決定是否需要曝光後烘烤。
假設接觸開口底部有殘留，沿圖往前追查光阻殘膜、蝕刻不足與清洗不充分三種可能；為每一個假說指定能區分它的觀察，而不是只增加蝕刻時間。
在工作單保留「停止」與「待查證」節點。若材料相容性、量測方式或前後順序不明，記下要查的原始技術文件，避免把未知寫成既定配方。
procedureEn: Choose a simplified MOS cross-section from a public reference. Redraw substrate, dielectric, gate, contact and interconnect in different colors; label the drawing as not to scale and do not assign advanced-node dimensions.

For each layer, record existing material, material to add or remove, protected regions and an available measurement. A contact opening in a dielectric requires pattern transfer, but an opening alone does not establish acceptable contact resistance.

Connect deposition, coating, exposure, applicable post-exposure bake, development, etch, strip and inspection in a directed graph. Add only physical dependencies; determine whether a post-exposure bake applies from the selected resist documentation.

Assume residue remains at a contact bottom. Trace three hypotheses: resist scum, incomplete etch and inadequate cleaning. Specify an observation that distinguishes each hypothesis instead of simply extending etch time.

Keep stop and unresolved nodes in the worksheet. When compatibility, measurement or ordering is unknown, name the original technical document needed rather than treating an assumption as an established recipe.
evidence: 交付帶材料狀態的依存圖、三個可被觀察推翻的缺陷假說，以及來源表。合格判準是每條箭頭能解釋「為何必須先做」，不是圖上節點越多越好。
如果使用來源中的顯微圖，記錄材料、尺度、取樣位置與來源；不要把影片動畫當作量測證據。
evidenceEn: Deliver a material-state dependency graph, three falsifiable defect hypotheses and a reference table. Each arrow must explain why one action precedes another; a larger node count is not the success criterion.
For referenced micrographs, record material, scale, sampling location and provenance. Animation frames are not measurement evidence.
pitfalls: 把所有 CMOS 架構拼成同一片晶圓必經的流程。
看見圖案就假定材料、電性和污染全都合格。
pitfallsEn: Combining all CMOS architectures into one mandatory wafer route.
Assuming a visible pattern establishes material, electrical and contamination quality.

guides.title: 光阻不是顏料：建立曝光與顯影的判讀表
guides.titleEn: Photoresist is not paint: interpret exposure and development
guides.concept: 曝光改變光阻的化學狀態，顯影將這種差異轉成形狀。殘留、線寬偏差或倒塌可能來自塗膜、烘烤、曝光和顯影的交互影響。這份練習建立診斷方法，不提供化學品配製或機台設定。
guides.conceptEn: Exposure changes the chemical state of resist; development converts that difference into geometry. Residue, dimensional bias or collapse can involve coating, baking, exposure and development together. This exercise develops diagnosis rather than chemical formulations or equipment settings.
procedure: 先從所選光阻的官方說明辨認正型、負型或影像反轉模式。畫出曝光區與保留區；如果使用不同光阻，重新建立圖，不沿用原本的顯影方向。
建立一張欄為曝光條件、列為顯影條件的空白比較表，填入自行取得且具有相同膜厚與基材的資料。沒有資料時，只畫假說趨勢並明確標為預測。
對每格記錄開口是否清底、保留區剩餘膜厚、特徵寬度及缺陷類型。使用同一測量定義和位置，避免拿不同倍率或不同圖形密度的影像直接排名。
若開口殘留但保留區完整，提出曝光不足與顯影不足兩個假說；若兩區都過度損失，檢查選擇性、膜厚與烘烤狀態。用額外觀察排除假說，不一次改動所有因素。
圈出同時符合自己先訂判準的區域，標示其邊緣最容易失效的指標。用重複資料檢查穩健性；只有單張漂亮影像時，不宣稱已找到製程窗口。
procedureEn: Identify positive, negative or image-reversal operation from the selected resist documentation. Draw exposed and retained regions; rebuild this map when changing resist rather than reusing the previous development polarity.

Create an empty matrix of exposure versus development conditions. Populate it with data you obtain for consistent film thickness and substrate. Without data, draw only clearly labeled hypothetical trends.

Record opening clearance, retained-film thickness, feature width and defect type for each cell. Use consistent measurement definitions and locations; do not directly rank images taken at different magnifications or pattern densities.

For residue in openings with intact retained resist, propose underexposure and underdevelopment as separate hypotheses. If both regions erode excessively, examine selectivity, thickness and bake state. Discriminate hypotheses with additional observations rather than changing every factor.

Identify regions meeting criteria you defined in advance and note the metric most likely to fail at each boundary. Assess robustness using repeat data; one attractive image does not establish a process window.
evidence: 提交附資料來源的比較表，或明確標為假說的空白計畫；列出至少一個能區分兩個成因的觀察。
說明正負型光阻保留區的差異，以及為何清底與保留膜厚必須同時檢查。
evidenceEn: Submit a comparison matrix with data provenance, or an explicitly hypothetical study plan; include an observation that separates two potential causes.
Explain retained-region polarity and why opening clearance and remaining film thickness must be checked together.
pitfalls: 把正型光阻的曝光效果直接套到所有負型材料。
只求開口清空而忽略遮罩膜厚被消耗。
把廠商示例參數當成未知材料可直接使用的設定。
pitfallsEn: Applying positive-resist exposure behavior to every negative material.
Clearing openings while ignoring loss of masking thickness.
Treating a supplier example as a usable setting for an unspecified material.

guides.title: 奈米片釋放：用剖面追蹤選擇性與可達性
guides.titleEn: Nanosheet release: track selectivity and access in cross-section
guides.concept: 堆疊 GAA 的重要挑戰是保留通道，同時移除其間的犧牲材料，並在狹窄空間建立連續的閘極堆疊。結構概念能公開學習，但影片不揭露特定晶圓廠的材料配比、蝕刻配方或驗收門檻。
guides.conceptEn: A central stacked-GAA challenge is preserving channels while removing intervening sacrificial material and forming a continuous gate stack in narrow spaces. The structural concept is public; a video does not disclose foundry-specific compositions, etch recipes or acceptance limits.
procedure: 用不同顏色畫出通道與犧牲層的交替堆疊，標示蝕刻物種可能進入及副產物離開的方向。只畫結構關係，不填入未公開的厚度或濃度。
在副本中移除犧牲層，檢查內側、外側及底部是否都能被接觸。比較「入口先變寬、深處仍殘留」與「通道也被侵蝕」兩種失效圖。
補上內側間隔層和源汲極的位置，追查它們如何界定後續閘極與源汲極的相鄰區域。將可能的寄生電容路徑用另一種顏色標示。
在釋放後空間畫出介電層與閘極金屬，檢查狹縫提早封口是否可能留下空隙。把蝕刻成功與後續填充成功列為兩個獨立的驗證項目。
若參考公開 TEM 圖，記錄它能證明的局部形貌與不能直接證明的漏電、變異或全晶圓良率。提出一項形貌與一項電性觀察的配對驗證計畫。
procedureEn: Draw alternating channel and sacrificial layers in different colors. Mark access for reactants and removal of by-products. Show structural relationships without inventing unpublished thicknesses or compositions.

Remove sacrificial layers in a copy and check access to inner, outer and bottom regions. Contrast two failure sketches: a widened entrance with residual material deeper inside, and unwanted channel erosion.
Add inner spacers and source/drain regions to trace how they define adjacency between the future gate and source/drain. Mark potential parasitic-capacitance paths in another color.

Draw dielectric and gate metal inside the released space. Check whether premature closure could leave a void. Treat successful release and successful subsequent fill as independent verification questions.

For a public TEM image, record the local morphology it supports and the leakage, variation or wafer-wide yield it cannot directly establish. Propose a paired morphological and electrical verification plan.
evidence: 交付釋放前、釋放後與閘極填充後三張原創剖面，及「殘留／通道損失／填充空隙」三類缺陷的可觀察差異。
成功的教學結果是能指出不同資料的證據邊界；不以圖中奈米片數量推算某節點的真實效能。
evidenceEn: Deliver original cross-sections before release, after release and after gate fill, with observable differences among residue, channel loss and fill voids.
Success means identifying evidence limits; do not infer real node performance from the number of sheets drawn.
pitfalls: 把選擇性當成永遠不會損傷通道的保證。
用一個理想剖面替代多位置的統計量測。
將節點名稱直接當作通道厚度。
pitfallsEn: Treating selectivity as a guarantee of zero channel damage.
Replacing multi-location statistics with one ideal cross-section.
Using a node label as channel thickness.

guides.title: 背面供電：把收益與整合代價放在同一張圖
guides.titleEn: Backside power: map benefits and integration costs together
guides.concept: 背面供電重新分配供電與訊號互連的空間。它可能改善供電路徑和布線條件，但不能只靠一條較短的線證明整顆晶片更快或更省電；接點、熱路徑、製造與失效分析也必須納入。
guides.conceptEn: Backside power redistributes the space used for power and signals. It can improve delivery paths and routing conditions, but a shorter line alone cannot establish a faster or more efficient chip. Contacts, thermal paths, fabrication and failure analysis also matter.
procedure: 使用相同的簡化負載方塊，畫一版前面供電與一版背面供電。分別標出外部電源、封裝、晶片金屬、垂直接點與電晶體，避免把晶片改善與封裝改善混在一起。
把每段路徑視為電阻並標上來源或未知。用 Vdrop = I × R 與 Ploss = I² × R 做趨勢比較；只使用自訂教學假設或可追溯資料，並在表中保留單位。
在同一張圖增加訊號佈線與散熱方向，說明釋出的佈線空間不會自動消除所有 RC 延遲。提出可能因接點、局部熱點或路徑不均勻而出現的限制。
建立製造檢查清單：背面接觸的對準、晶圓支撐與厚度控制、連接完整性，以及失效定位可達性。每項只寫需要何種證據，不捏造機台操作設定。
比較時固定電壓、工作負載和量測邊界，並把影片中的歷史路線圖和已公布量測分欄。無法固定條件的效能百分比，標為不能直接比較。
procedureEn: Use the same simplified load blocks for frontside- and backside-powered drawings. Label external supply, package, chip metals, vertical contacts and transistors so chip-level improvements are not conflated with package changes.

Represent each path segment by a resistance with a source or unknown label. Compare trends using Vdrop = I × R and Ploss = I² × R. Use declared educational assumptions or traceable data, keeping units visible.
Add signal routing and heat-flow directions. Explain why freed routing space does not automatically remove all RC delay. Identify limitations from contacts, local hotspots or uneven delivery paths.

Create a manufacturing evidence checklist covering backside-contact alignment, wafer support and thickness control, connection integrity and fault-localization access. Specify the evidence needed without inventing tool settings.

Hold voltage, workload and measurement boundary fixed when comparing cases. Separate historical roadmaps from published measurements. Mark performance percentages as non-comparable when conditions cannot be matched.
evidence: 提交兩張剖面、一張含假設與單位的等效電阻表，以及一項電性、一項熱、一項製造驗證需求。
若使用簡化電阻模型，結論只能涉及所建模的壓降與損耗，不可宣稱已模擬電晶體速度、電感暫態或完整熱可靠性。
evidenceEn: Submit two cross-sections, an equivalent-resistance table with assumptions and units, and electrical, thermal and manufacturing verification needs.
A resistance model supports only its modeled drop and loss; it does not simulate transistor speed, inductive transients or full thermal reliability.
pitfalls: 只算電源線而漏掉封裝及接點電阻。
把 2021 年的預定時程寫成今天的量產事實。
將 GAA 和背面供電當成同一項技術。
pitfallsEn: Counting power lines while omitting package and contact resistance.
Presenting a 2021 schedule as current production fact.
Treating GAA and backside power as the same technology.

guides.title: 線條印得小，並不等於每層對得準
guides.titleEn: Small printed features and accurate layer overlay are different
guides.concept: 解析度描述可分辨的圖案尺度；套刻描述不同層的位置關係。微影系統需要光學、載台、晶圓形貌量測與回饋共同工作。把兩個指標分開，才能知道改善 NA、焦距控制或位置校正各自處理什麼問題。
guides.conceptEn: Resolution describes separable pattern scale; overlay describes relative placement of layers. Lithography depends on optics, stages, wafer-shape measurement and feedback together. Keeping the metrics separate clarifies which problems numerical aperture, focus control and position correction address.
procedure: 先用本網站示意或自製線條圖，建立「線寬變粗／線條模糊」和「整層平移」兩組例子。保持標示尺度一致，並說明兩者可能同時出現。
用 CD ≈ k1 × λ / NA 比較只改波長或只改 NA 的相對趨勢。固定另一變數並註明 k1 是模型參數；此公式不提供某晶圓廠的節點名稱、良率或完整曝光窗口。
在兩層標記圖上量出多個位置的 x、y 位移。先擬合平移，再考慮旋轉或尺度差異；記錄校正前後殘差，避免只把中心位置對齊就宣稱全片合格。
將焦點與劑量另外列成兩個變數。若邊緣變模糊卻沒有整層位移，提出焦點、光阻或圖形對比等假說；如果線條清晰但偏離底層，優先檢查套刻資料。
規劃量測取樣：至少說明為何要涵蓋不同曝光場及場內位置。將量測不確定度和校正後殘差分開記錄，並保留尚未驗證的高階誤差。
procedureEn: Using the site schematic or your own line drawing, construct examples of broadened or blurred lines and examples of a translated layer. Keep scale labels consistent and explain that both errors can coexist.

Compare relative trends with CD ≈ k1 × λ / NA while varying wavelength or NA separately. State that k1 is a model parameter; this relation does not supply a foundry node label, yield or complete exposure window.

Measure x and y offsets at several positions on a two-layer marker drawing. Fit translation first, then consider rotation or scale. Record residuals before and after correction instead of declaring success from the center alone.

Treat focus and dose as separate variables. For blurred edges without layer translation, consider focus, resist or image-contrast hypotheses. For sharp but displaced features, first inspect overlay evidence.
Plan sampling across exposure fields and within fields. Record measurement uncertainty separately from post-correction residuals and retain higher-order errors that have not been tested.
evidence: 交付兩組錯誤示意、一張標有假設的解析度比較表，及校正前後位移殘差圖；資料可以自行建立，但必須標為教學示意。
檢核是否能解釋：提升 NA 不能直接校正所有層間位移；量測解析度與晶片功能良率也是不同證據。
evidenceEn: Deliver two error illustrations, a resolution comparison with assumptions and a before/after offset-residual plot. Self-created values must be labeled educational illustrations.
Check that you can explain why increasing NA does not directly correct all layer offsets, and why metrology resolution differs from functional chip yield.
pitfalls: 把 NA 的數值直接當成可製造節點的名稱。
只看單點偏移，忽略場內與場間變化。
用線條清晰代替套刻合格的判斷。
pitfallsEn: Treating an NA value as a manufacturable node label.
Ignoring within-field and across-field variation after inspecting one point.
Using sharp lines as evidence of acceptable overlay.

guides.title: EUV 光路：從光源到晶圓的能量帳本
guides.titleEn: EUV optical path: an energy ledger from source to wafer
guides.concept: EUV 系統採用反射光學與真空環境，原因涉及材料對 EUV 的吸收。每一個子系統都有傳輸損失、穩定度和污染控制問題。系統工程必須連接這些界面，不能把光源規格直接當成晶圓可用曝光能量。
guides.conceptEn: EUV systems use reflective optics and vacuum because material absorption matters strongly at EUV wavelengths. Each subsystem introduces transmission losses, stability requirements and contamination concerns. Systems engineering connects these interfaces rather than equating source specifications with usable wafer exposure energy.
procedure: 依官方光路導覽，用自己的方塊圖標出光源、收集器、照明光學、光罩、投影光學和晶圓。用實線標光能路徑、虛線標量測與回饋，不重製受保護的機台施工圖。
給每個光學界面一個符號傳輸係數 ηi，寫出 Pwafer = Psource × ∏ηi。只有取得對應定義和量測邊界的資料時才填數值；沒有資料時比較相對變化即可。
假設某界面傳輸下降，追蹤在其他條件固定時需要補償的光源輸出或曝光時間。說明此靜態帳本沒有包含掃描同步、熱漂移、脈衝變異或維護停機。
在每個方塊附一項可能觀察：功率穩定性、波前／成像變化、污染跡象或位置殘差。若曝光劑量下降，提出至少兩個可能位置及一項能分辨它們的量測。
把「提高功率」和「維持影像品質」分成兩條驗證鏈。新增功率可能改變熱負載，必須重新考慮形變與控制，而非假設所有光學係數固定不變。
procedureEn: Redraw the official optical tour as source, collector, illumination optics, mask, projection optics and wafer. Use solid lines for optical energy and dashed lines for measurement and feedback; do not reproduce proprietary assembly drawings.

Assign each optical interface a symbolic transmission factor ηi and write Pwafer = Psource × ∏ηi. Populate values only when definitions and measurement boundaries match; otherwise compare relative changes.

Assume transmission falls at one interface and trace the compensating source output or exposure time with other factors held fixed. State that this static ledger omits scan synchronization, thermal drift, pulse variation and maintenance downtime.

Attach an observation to each block: power stability, wavefront or image change, contamination indication or positioning residual. For reduced exposure dose, identify at least two possible locations and a discriminating measurement.

Separate the verification chains for more power and maintained image quality. Added power may change thermal loading, so reconsider deformation and control rather than assuming every optical coefficient stays constant.
evidence: 提交光路圖、含單位與邊界的能量帳本，以及兩個故障假說的辨識計畫。可以用任意清楚標示的教學係數演算，但不可稱為 ASML 機台規格。
說明 EUV 使用鏡面與真空的物理原因，並指出此帳本不能預測晶圓每小時產量或成品良率。
evidenceEn: Submit an optical diagram, an energy ledger with units and boundaries, and a plan distinguishing two fault hypotheses. Arbitrary educational coefficients are acceptable if labeled and never presented as ASML specifications.
Explain the physical rationale for mirrors and vacuum and identify why this ledger cannot predict wafers per hour or final yield.
pitfalls: 把所有鏡面的反射率都假定為 100%。
將來源中的光源功率和晶圓面功率混用。
用光路圖宣稱已掌握真實機台裝配與校準技術。
pitfallsEn: Assuming every mirror reflects 100% of the incident power.
Mixing source power with wafer-plane power.
Claiming an optical diagram provides real machine assembly and calibration expertise.

guides.title: 先畫資料流，再決定中介層或矽橋
guides.titleEn: Map data flow before choosing an interposer or bridge
guides.concept: 先進封裝把不同功能晶粒連成系統。中介層、局部矽橋及垂直堆疊提供不同的連接幾何；選擇必須同時考慮 I/O 位置、連線密度、供電、熱、測試和組裝條件。品牌名稱不是可以互換的配方。
guides.conceptEn: Advanced packaging connects functional dies into a system. Interposers, local silicon bridges and vertical stacking offer different connection geometries. Choices depend on I/O placement, connection density, power, heat, testing and assembly conditions together; brand names are not interchangeable recipes.
procedure: 選一個教學系統，例如邏輯晶粒加高頻寬記憶體，畫出功能與資料方向。為每條連接記錄資料率的定義、方向、通道數和時脈假設；未知值保持未知。
畫兩種平面配置：一種以較廣的中介層連接，另一種只在相鄰晶粒邊緣配置局部橋。用不同顏色標示高速訊號、電源與低速控制線。
檢查每條重要路徑是否能到達正確的 I/O 邊界，是否存在交叉、繞路或間距衝突。不能只把方塊靠近就假定走線容量足夠。
在配置圖加上熱源、可能的冷卻路徑與測試存取點。提出一個為減少走線而移動晶粒、卻使熱或測試變差的例子，練習共同設計的取捨。
建立比較表，將幾何可行性、電性模型、組裝對準、已知良品晶粒與供應鏈限制分欄。對沒有可追溯成本或良率資料的方案，只做條件式結論。
procedureEn: Choose an educational system such as a logic die with high-bandwidth memory and map functions and data directions. For each link, record rate definition, direction, lane count and clock assumptions; preserve unknown values.
Draw two floorplans: a broader interposer and local bridges at adjacent die edges. Color high-speed signals, power and low-speed control separately.
Check whether each important path reaches the correct I/O boundary and encounters crossing, detour or spacing conflicts. Placing blocks close together does not establish adequate routing capacity.
Add heat sources, possible cooling paths and test access. Give an example where moving a die to reduce routing worsens heat removal or testability, exposing a co-design tradeoff.

Compare geometric feasibility, electrical models, assembly alignment, known-good-die evidence and supply constraints in separate columns. Make only conditional conclusions without traceable cost or yield data.
evidence: 提交兩張配置圖、一張介面清單與條件式比較表。每條重要連接都應有起點、終點、方向和待驗證項目。
解釋兩種配置各有何限制，並指出資料尚不足時不宜宣稱哪種一定更便宜或更快。
evidenceEn: Submit two floorplans, an interface register and a conditional comparison. Every important connection should have endpoints, direction and an unresolved verification item.
Explain constraints of both layouts and why missing data prevents unconditional claims of lower cost or higher speed.
pitfalls: 把 EMIB、CoWoS 和 SoIC 視為同一種結構。
只比較平面面積，忽略基板、供電、冷卻及測試。
把示意圖上的連線當成已完成訊號完整性分析。
pitfallsEn: Treating EMIB, CoWoS and SoIC as the same structure.
Comparing footprint alone while ignoring substrate, power, cooling and testing.
Treating lines in a drawing as completed signal-integrity analysis.

guides.title: 3D 堆疊：一起追蹤熱路徑、互連與可測試性
guides.titleEn: 3D stacking: trace heat paths, interconnects and testability together
guides.concept: 垂直堆疊縮短部分連接並增加整合密度，同時改變熱路徑、接合界面與測試方式。單顆晶粒測試通過，不代表接合後沒有缺陷；連接密度提高也不代表熱限制自然消失。
guides.conceptEn: Vertical stacking shortens some connections and increases integration density while changing heat paths, bonding interfaces and test methods. A die passing standalone tests does not prove a defect-free assembled stack, and denser connections do not remove thermal constraints.
procedure: 畫出兩層晶粒、接合界面、封裝基板與散熱面的剖面。將訊號、供電和熱三種路徑分開追蹤，並標示哪個路徑是教學假設。
建立簡化熱阻網路，先用 ΔT ≈ P × Rθ 觀察單一熱源的趨勢。加入第二層熱源時，註明互相加熱和三維擴散需要更完整模型，不把各層獨立溫升直接相加當作精確答案。
在接合界面畫出未對準、局部未接合與電性開路三種可能。分別提出位置觀察、界面觀察及電性連續性測試；說明它們能支持但不能互相取代的結論。
安排接合前、接合後、最終組裝後三個測試關卡，記錄各關卡可接觸哪些節點、能發現哪些故障。把未測到的故障保留在風險表，不把已知良品晶粒當作零風險。
提出一版重新安排熱源或調整測試存取的方案，列出它對佈線與組裝的副作用。以證據完整性比較方案，而不是只選剖面看起來最密集的版本。
procedureEn: Draw two die tiers, the bonding interface, package substrate and cooling surface in cross-section. Trace signal, power and heat separately and identify educational assumptions.

Build a simplified thermal-resistance network and use ΔT ≈ P × Rθ to inspect a single-source trend. With a second heat source, state that mutual heating and three-dimensional spreading need a fuller model; do not sum isolated temperature rises as an exact result.

Illustrate misalignment, local nonbonding and electrical opens at the interface. Propose positional, interface and continuity observations, explaining which conclusions each can support without substituting one for another.

Schedule prebond, postbond and post-assembly test gates. Record accessible nodes and detectable faults at each stage. Retain untested fault classes in a risk table; known-good die does not mean zero assembly risk.
Propose a revised heat-source arrangement or test-access scheme and list side effects on routing and assembly. Compare evidence completeness rather than selecting the visually densest cross-section.
evidence: 交付三路徑剖面、熱模型假設表，以及「故障類型→檢查方法→可判斷與不可判斷事項」對照表。
驗收是能說清楚最弱的證據環節及下一個需要的測試；本工作單不等同產品可靠度認證。
evidenceEn: Deliver a three-path cross-section, thermal-model assumptions and a fault-to-observation table stating what can and cannot be concluded.
Acceptance means identifying the weakest evidence link and the next needed test; this worksheet is not product reliability qualification.
pitfalls: 把薄化晶粒一律視為更冷或更可靠。
用單一影像推論所有互連都導通。
把廠商特定堆疊世代的參數混在同一個模型。
pitfallsEn: Assuming thinner dies are always cooler or more reliable.
Inferring all interconnects conduct from one image.
Mixing parameters from different vendor-specific stacking generations.

guides.title: 先做光功率帳本，再談連線能否工作
guides.titleEn: Build an optical power budget before judging a link
guides.concept: 光學互連包含光源、調變、耦合、傳輸、偵測與電子電路。光功率足夠只是必要條件之一；頻寬、雜訊、抖動與誤碼表現還需要另外證據。先定義功率量測的起點與終點，才能公平比較配置。
guides.conceptEn: An optical interconnect includes generation, modulation, coupling, transmission, detection and electronics. Adequate optical power is only one requirement; bandwidth, noise, jitter and error performance need separate evidence. Define the start and end of power measurements before comparing architectures.
procedure: 畫出發射器到接收器的功能鏈，在每個光／電轉換處分界。標示雷射是外接還是整合案例，並記錄使用哪個來源作為架構依據，不假設所有矽光子都採同一光源。
建立損耗表：耦合器、波導、彎曲、連接器與分光等項目分列。對長度相關損耗，先確認資料單位是 dB/m 還是 dB/cm，再乘上對應長度。
用 Prx(dBm) = Ptx(dBm) − ΣL(dB) 計算簡化接收功率；若加入分光，列出理想分配與額外損耗。缺少可追溯數字時，保留符號或明確標示自訂教學值。
把接收器靈敏度、飽和界限、目標資料率和測試條件列在另一欄。只有條件相符時才計算餘裕；沒有接收器文件時，不能把正的光功率直接稱為連線通過。
改變一項耦合損耗或路徑長度，觀察餘裕趨勢，再列出此帳本缺少的頻寬與誤碼驗證。說明零觀察到錯誤仍需測試位元數和信賴度背景。
procedureEn: Draw the transmitter-to-receiver chain with boundaries at optical/electrical conversions. Identify an external or integrated laser in the chosen reference architecture; do not assume all silicon photonics uses the same source.

Build a loss table for couplers, waveguides, bends, connectors and splitters as applicable. For length-dependent loss, check whether the unit is dB/m or dB/cm before multiplying by the matching length.

Calculate a simplified received power with Prx(dBm) = Ptx(dBm) − ΣL(dB). For splitters, distinguish ideal division from excess loss. Keep symbols or explicitly educational values when traceable numbers are unavailable.

List receiver sensitivity, saturation limit, target data rate and test conditions separately. Calculate margin only for matching conditions; without receiver documentation, nonzero optical power cannot establish a working link.

Vary one coupling loss or path length to inspect margin trends, then list missing bandwidth and error-rate verification. Explain that observing zero errors still requires bit-count and confidence context.
evidence: 提交帶量測邊界的功能圖、單位一致的損耗表與來源／假設標記。用一個例子說明 dBm 是功率基準，而 dB 是比值。
結論分成「光功率預算可行」與「通訊品質仍待驗證」，不能把前者當作誤碼測試結果。
evidenceEn: Submit a functional diagram with measurement boundaries, a unit-consistent loss table and source/assumption labels. Use an example to distinguish absolute dBm power from a dB ratio.
Separate optical-budget feasibility from communication quality still requiring verification; the former is not a bit-error-rate result.
pitfalls: 直接相加 dBm 值來合併不同光源。
漏掉耦合界面或把波導長度單位弄錯。
只看總雙向頻寬而忽略每方向和每通道的定義。
pitfallsEn: Adding dBm values directly to combine optical sources.
Omitting coupling interfaces or mismatching waveguide-length units.
Using aggregate bidirectional bandwidth without defining directions and lanes.

guides.title: 環形共振器：讀懂共振、線寬與溫度漂移
guides.titleEn: Ring resonators: interpret resonance, linewidth and thermal drift
guides.concept: 環形共振器依靠光在環路中累積的相位與耦合來選擇波長。共振位置、線寬、損耗與耦合不是同一個參數；溫度或製程變異也可能讓工作點偏移。這份練習使用圖表與公開模型概念，不宣稱網站內建完整電磁求解器。
guides.conceptEn: A ring resonator selects wavelengths through round-trip phase and coupling. Resonance position, linewidth, loss and coupling are distinct quantities; temperature or fabrication variation can shift the operating point. This exercise uses plots and public model concepts, not a claimed built-in full-wave electromagnetic solver.
procedure: 畫出單匯流排環形結構並標示 through port；若改用 add-drop 結構，另外標出 drop port。先預測共振時在哪一個埠看見凹谷或峰值，再對照所選模型的埠定義。
從自行取得或參考來源的傳輸頻譜讀出相鄰共振位置與半高全寬。記錄座標是波長還是頻率，以及訊號是功率還是場振幅，避免用不同定義直接計算。
在適用定義下估算 FSR 與 loaded Q ≈ λres / Δλ，並標示取樣解析度。若頻譜點太稀，回報線寬無法可靠解析，不把插值曲線當作新增量測。
用共振條件與有效折射率的概念，預測改變環路長度或溫度會移動共振位置。對溫度掃描，固定其他假設，並說明調諧所需功率及跨通道熱影響仍待資料。
比較兩條相同正規化方式的頻譜，區分共振位置偏移、凹谷深度改變與線寬改變。提出損耗或耦合變化等不同假說，說明僅一條頻譜可能無法唯一反推出所有參數。
procedureEn: Draw a single-bus ring and label the through port. For an add-drop structure, label the drop port separately. Predict which port shows a dip or peak at resonance, then check the selected model’s port definitions.

Read adjacent resonance positions and full width at half maximum from spectra you supply or obtain from references. Record wavelength versus frequency axes and power versus field amplitude before calculating.

Where definitions apply, estimate FSR and loaded Q ≈ λres / Δλ, recording sampling resolution. If sampling is too sparse, report unresolved linewidth instead of treating interpolation as new measurement.

Use the resonance condition and effective-index concept to predict shifts with ring length or temperature. Hold other assumptions fixed in a temperature sweep and identify missing tuning-power and thermal-crosstalk data.

Compare two consistently normalized spectra to distinguish shifted resonance, changed dip depth and changed linewidth. Propose loss and coupling hypotheses and explain why one spectrum may not uniquely determine every parameter.
evidence: 提交有埠標示的原創圖、兩條具有來源或假設標記的頻譜比較，以及 Q 與 FSR 的定義和單位。
指出資料解析度與參數可辨識性的限制；能解釋峰／谷差異，而不是背誦某一種曲線形狀。
evidenceEn: Submit an original port-labeled drawing, a two-spectrum comparison with provenance or assumption labels, and Q/FSR definitions and units.
Identify resolution and parameter-identifiability limits; explain peak/dip behavior rather than memorizing one curve shape.
pitfalls: 把 through port 的凹谷和 drop port 的峰值搞混。
用場振幅半高代替功率半高而不說明。
將 loaded Q 當成單獨材料吸收損耗。
pitfallsEn: Confusing through-port dips with drop-port peaks.
Substituting field-amplitude half-height for power half-height without explanation.
Treating loaded Q as material-absorption loss alone.
